issue: Recurring /loop macro: Wave 5 research and implementation of trios-mesh daemon panic hardening and runtime-state isolation.
problem: trios-mesh production code contained 9 expect calls on crypto primitives plus 1 in discovery MAC computation; the unregistered trios-meshd binary panicked on bad config, bind failure, and missing files and used world-writable /tmp/mesh.drop; the workspace lint expect_used was only warn, allowing new panic surfaces to land.
fix: Added MeshError::CryptoInternal and propagated Result through crypto.rs, discovery.rs, and all callers. Rewrote trios_meshd.rs with Result-based startup, line-numbered config errors, mutex poison recovery, and .trinity/run/mesh.drop default with TRIOS_MESH_DROP override. Elevated workspace expect_used/unwrap_used to deny and added test-only exemptions. ASCII-cleaned touched source, specs, and skills.
tests_added: Existing trios-mesh 101 tests + clade-meshd 2 tests continue to pass; no new tests added.
verification: ./build.sh passed; cargo test -p trios-mesh --all-features passed 101 tests; cargo test -p clade-meshd --all-features passed 2 tests; cargo clippy -p trios-mesh -p clade-meshd --all-targets --all-features clean; ASCII scan of changed files clean; no expect/unwrap violations in production code.
pattern: Convert daemon production expect/unwrap to Result propagation with a domain-internal error variant, add workspace clippy deny, exempt tests only, and move runtime /tmp state to project-relative paths with env override.
anti_pattern: Do not use expect/unwrap on I/O, crypto, or config in daemon code; do not use world-writable /tmp for runtime state; do not register a binary with API drift.
